name: karobakbak
description: Anonymous real-time random stranger chat. Ephemeral text only.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run verify:protocol && npm run verify:config && npm run verify:pending-policy && npm run verify:workflows && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:frontend
scripts.personas:on: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U karobakbak -d karobakbak -c "update persona_control set enabled = true, updated_by = 'operator', reason = 'enabled locally' where scope = 'global';"
scripts.personas:off: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U karobakbak -d karobakbak -c "update persona_control set enabled = false, mode = 'drain', updated_by = 'operator', reason = 'disabled locally' where scope = 'global';"
scripts.personas:status: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U karobakbak -d karobakbak -c "select scope, subject, enabled, mode, updated_by, reason from persona_control order by scope;" -c "select persona_id, replies, cost_micro_cents, flagged, limits_tripped, started_at from persona_conversations order by started_at desc limit 10;"
scripts.psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U karobakbak -d karobakbak
scripts.loadtest: npm run loadtest:up && k6 run -e WS_URL=ws://localhost:8090/ws load-test/websocket.js
scripts.sentinel:up: docker compose --env-file .env.loadtest -p karobakbak-sentinel -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.sentinel.yml -f docker-compose.sentinel-app.yml up --build -d
scripts.sentinel:down: docker compose --env-file .env.loadtest -p karobakbak-sentinel -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.sentinel.yml -f docker-compose.sentinel-app.yml down -v
scripts.sentinel:status: docker exec karobakbak-sentinel-1 redis-cli -p 26379 sentinel master karobakbak
scripts.swarm: npm run loadtest:up && npm --prefix load-test/swarm run swarm --
scripts.swarm:full: npm run loadtest:up && npm --prefix load-test/swarm run swarm -- --redis karobakbak-loadtest-redis-1 --metrics karobakbak-loadtest-backend-1,karobakbak-loadtest-backend-2 --containers karobakbak-loadtest-backend-1,karobakbak-loadtest-backend-2 --postgres karobakbak-loadtest-postgres-1
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f backend
scripts.unblock:loadtest: docker compose --env-file .env.loadtest -p karobakbak-loadtest exec -T redis redis-cli EVAL "local n=0 for _,p in ipairs({'chat:blocks:*','chat:last_partner:*'}) do for _,k in ipairs(redis.call('KEYS',p)) do redis.call('DEL',k) n=n+1 end end return n" 0
scripts.payments:migrate:loadtest: docker compose --env-file .env.loadtest -p karobakbak-loadtest exec -T postgres psql -U karobakbak -d karobakbak -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < backend/src/storage/migrations-pending/011_payments.sql
scripts.unblock: docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli EVAL "local n=0 for _,p in ipairs({'chat:blocks:*','chat:last_partner:*'}) do for _,k in ipairs(redis.call('KEYS',p)) do redis.call('DEL',k) n=n+1 end end return n" 0
scripts.vps:up: docker compose --env-file .env.vps -p karobakbak-vps -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.vps.yml up --build -d --scale grafana=0 --scale loki=0 --scale tempo=0 --scale alloy=0 --scale cadvisor=0 --scale redis-exporter=0 --scale postgres-exporter=0
scripts.vps:down: docker compose --env-file .env.vps -p karobakbak-vps -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.vps.yml down -v
scripts.vps:stats: docker stats --no-stream --format "table {{.Name}}	{{.CPUPerc}}	{{.MemUsage}}	{{.MemPerc}}" karobakbak-vps-frontend-1 karobakbak-vps-backend-1 karobakbak-vps-redis-1 karobakbak-vps-postgres-1 karobakbak-vps-prometheus-1
scripts.vps:climb: npm --prefix load-test/swarm run swarm -- --url ws://localhost:8091/ws --origin http://localhost:8091 --workers 6
scripts.vps:ps: docker compose --env-file .env.vps -p karobakbak-vps -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.vps.yml ps
